title: Frequently asked questions
intro: Clear answers to the questions we hear most, without spin and without promises.

items.q: Can I borrow while listed for a credit incident?
items.a: Classic credit granted on a score will be refused, but financing backed by collateral can be studied. The eligibility check tells you honestly where you stand.

items.q: Do you accept the self-employed without three years of accounts?
items.a: Yes, under conditions: an established business and steady statements can make up for the missing accounts.

items.q: Is a fixed-term or temp contract a deal-breaker?
items.a: No. A short contract weakens the file but does not make it impossible, especially with track record in the same field or a co-borrower.

items.q: Is the APR guaranteed in advance?
items.a: No. The rates shown are indicative. The final APR appears on your contract offer, after review of your file.

items.q: Why is the APR higher than the rate shown?
items.a: The APR is an effective rate that includes fees and any insurance: it is normal for it to be higher than the borrowing rate alone.
Depending on the product. Any fees are stated clearly in the offer, before you sign.

items.q: What do you do with my data?
items.a: It is used only to review your request and is accessed only by the people in charge of the review, in line with the privacy policy.
No. Until you submit a request, your answers stay on your device.

items.q: How long does the review take?
items.a: A clear review time is stated, and we stick to it. No artificial urgency, no countdown.

items.q: Is the eligibility check a credit approval?
items.a: No. It is honest guidance, without commitment or a shown score: it is not a credit decision.

items.q: Can I resume my application later?
items.a: Yes. Your answers are saved on your device while you finish, and cleared on submission.
